sentences.text: One honesty note: I've confirmed *where* Cowork reads skills, but the precise hand-off to register a **custom** skill into that manifest (vs. the Anthropic-managed ones) is the part I can't fully test from here — that's why routing it through the in-product `skill-creator`/`create-cowork-plugin` tool is safer than me hand-editing the managed `manifest.json` (which looks like it re-syncs and would wipe a manual entry).
